en-US.description: Secure artifact fetch-and-relocate tool with an embedded OCI registry.
en-US.longDescription:
Secure artifact fetch-and-relocate tool with an embedded OCI registry.
Tobby fetches OCI assets — container images, Helm charts, AI models,
and files — and carries them across isolated network zones, from
connected, through restricted, down to fully air-gapped environments.
en-US.name: tobby
en-US.releaseNotes:
Supply-chain verification
Every artifact below carries SLSA Build L3 provenance generated by the
slsa-github-generator trusted builder, a cosign-signed CycloneDX SBOM,
and reproducible-build guarantees. Full guide:
docs/release-verification.md.

Verify a binary against its SLSA provenance
slsa-verifier verify-artifact tobby-linux-amd64 \
  --provenance-path tobby.intoto.jsonl \
  --source-uri github.com/tobby-fetch/tobby-fetch \
  --source-tag v0.5.1

Linux packages (offline install)
tobby_0.5.1_linux_<arch>.deb|rpm|apk wrap the same
reproducible binary (installed to /usr/bin/tobby, no install
scripts) and are covered by the same SLSA provenance and
SHA256SUMS. Verify with slsa-verifier as above, then install
with no repository or network access:
dpkg -i tobby_0.5.1_linux_amd64.deb                    # Debian/Ubuntu
rpm -i tobby_0.5.1_linux_amd64.rpm                     # RHEL/SUSE/Fedora
apk add --allow-untrusted tobby_0.5.1_linux_amd64.apk  # Alpine
The packages carry no package-manager signature — trust comes
from the SLSA provenance and checksum verification performed
before installation (hence --allow-untrusted on apk).

Verify a signed SBOM
cosign verify-blob \
  --new-bundle-format \
  --bundle tobby-linux-amd64.cdx.json.bundle \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/tobby-fetch/tobby-fetch/' \
  tobby-linux-amd64.cdx.json

Container image
ghcr.io/tobby-fetch/tobby-fetch:v0.5.1 — digest sha256:87260a7c087895f789b48e4f6fb2e1631556cd7c9174e10e04ede591b962b1a3 (multi-arch amd64/arm64,
Wolfi-based, no shell, runs as uid 65532).
slsa-verifier verify-image ghcr.io/tobby-fetch/tobby-fetch@sha256:87260a7c087895f789b48e4f6fb2e1631556cd7c9174e10e04ede591b962b1a3 \
  --source-uri github.com/tobby-fetch/tobby-fetch \
  --source-tag v0.5.1
cosign verify ghcr.io/tobby-fetch/tobby-fetch@sha256:87260a7c087895f789b48e4f6fb2e1631556cd7c9174e10e04ede591b962b1a3 \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/tobby-fetch/tobby-fetch/'

Independent rebuild (air-gapped verification)
The binaries and Linux packages are bit-reproducible. Rebuild
them from the tag and compare against SHA256SUMS — no online
infrastructure required:
git clone https://github.com/tobby-fetch/tobby-fetch && cd tobby-fetch
git checkout v0.5.1
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct) sh tools/release-build.sh \
  "v0.5.1" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
  "$(date -u -d "@$(git log -1 --format=%ct)" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" dist
# optional — reproduces the .deb/.rpm/.apk too; needs nfpm at the
# NFPM_VERSION pinned in .github/workflows/release.yml
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct) sh tools/package-build.sh \
  "v0.5.1" dist dist
(cd dist && sha256sum --ignore-missing -c /path/to/downloaded/SHA256SUMS)
